findings: 91% of npm and PyPI advisories are malicious packages rather than bugs in real software.
192,552 malicious package reports are dated 2025, against 10,962 in 2024 and 14,819 so far in 2026. A swing that large suggests bulk reporting, so it is not a clean trend.
Ordinary vulnerability advisories reached 10,233 in 2026, against 1,575 in 2025.
